identity.name: HooHlyaShop
principles: Content is King: Images are the UI.
Motion must feel heavy and physical.

scale.h1: text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl uppercase tracking-tight leading-[0.9]
scale.caption: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground

usage.gradients: NONE. Use solid colors or noise textures.
usage.text_gradients: Allowed only on very large headings (e.g., White to Grey-500).

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise overlay to the background using a fixed pseudo-element.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-white hover:text-black rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary uppercase tracking-widest text-sm font-mono

cards.feature: bg-secondary/50 border border-white/5 p-8 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.default: bg-secondary border-transparent focus:border-primary rounded-none h-12 px-4 font-mono text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

hero.structure: Full-screen image/video background. Massive centered typography. Floating bottom controls.
hero.interaction: Parallax scroll effect on the background image.

catalog.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-1. First item spans 2 cols. Mix of product cards and 'lifestyle' filler images.
catalog.interaction: Images desaturated by default, full color on hover.

product_detail.structure: Left: Scrollable gallery (full width images). Right: Sticky product info and cart actions.
product_detail.interaction: Sticky sidebar must stay in view while images scroll.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with stroke-width={1.5} for a thin, elegant look.

transitions.page: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `npm install framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the colors and fonts defined above. Extend the theme, do not overwrite.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the @import for fonts in `index.css`. Set the root background color to #050505.
4. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for the product catalog. Do not use a simple uniform grid.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided Pexels URLs. Do not use placeholders.
6. ADMIN PANEL: Keep the admin panel simple but dark mode. Use a standard dashboard layout but with the project's color palette.
7. PDF GENERATION: Ensure the PDF button is prominent on the Cart page.
8. CONTACT: Add the WhatsApp/Telegram/Instagram buttons in the Footer and on the Product Detail page.
9. LANGUAGE: Implement a simple state-based language switcher (EN/DE). No need for complex i18n libraries if the content is small, but `react-i18next` is preferred if scalable.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
